_notes: Copy of this file lives at shared/profile.json after setup.sh runs.
profile.json is gitignored. Never commit your real profile.
Field names match what real Greenhouse + Ashby forms expect.
Leave a field as the placeholder if you do not want the skill to touch it.

demographics.veteran_status: I am not a protected veteran
demographics.disability_status: I do not wish to answer

standard_qa.why_company: Short default answer about why you want to work here. The skill may overwrite this per company.
standard_qa.why_role: Short default answer about why this role fits you.
standard_qa.preferred_work_arrangement: Open to onsite, hybrid, or remote

_notes: 用于 mrweirdo-jobs sourcing + AI matching。
role_types 决定 AI 接受什么类型的岗位；不在列表里的 role 会被 AI 自动 fit_score ≤ 3。
exclude_keywords：JD 或 title 含任何这些词，会触发 hard exclusion (fit_score -5)。
target_filters._batch_pace_options: fast | normal | slow | stealth — see mrweirdo-jobs SKILL.md for per-pace timing + daily caps. Default 'slow' for human-pacing (2-5 min jitter, 50/day cap).
target_filters._daily_apply_cap_notes: Hard cap on applications per 24h. Overrides batch_pace cap if lower.

greenhouse._notes: Greenhouse-specific tweaks. The country picker uses 'United States +1' with the space-+1 suffix.

ashby._notes: Ashby _systemfield_name is a single combined field, not first/last.
